name: english-textbooks-mcp
description: Read-only, model-independent English textbook tutor MCP

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types tests/corpus.test.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.check: npm run build:corpus && python3 scripts/validate_corpus.py && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.deploy:check: npm run check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
